answer: Sybil farms die on the money trail. Every new identity posts a 500 POA bond from a source wallet, and before its attestations count the node walks the deposit graph three hops up. Two accounts sharing an ancestor inside those hops get flagged; their votes weigh zero. A lone joiner funds one wallet from its own haven. Fifty clones need fifty distinct aged wallets, 25,000 POA locked, plus laundering to break the shared ancestor; run it through a 1% mixer and that mixer becomes the summit the graph finds. An island stands alone; a sybil is a chain of islands tied to one dock.
